memories_after: [Fact] (ticket:AGN-2 {"project":"docs"}) Merging in the docs project is performed by the system after report submission; the ticket stays Resolved until the Lead closes it.

[Fact] (ticket:AGN-2 {"project":"docs"}) In the docs project, team documents belong under reports/ and deliverables/, and coding reports are submitted via the agenium submit_report tool with per-AC evidence and artifact refs.

[Lesson] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) Before submitting a coding report, re-read the files you wrote and check both the ticket's content criterion and the project's pre-merge rules (such as the exact first-line document header); a successful Write call does not prove the content satisfies those rules.

[Lesson] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) When a pre-merge check rejects a document, copy the exact required string from the check message (e.g. 'Owner: docs-team') into the file's first line instead of paraphrasing it.

[Fact] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) In the docs project, every team document placed in deliverables/ or reports/ must have the exact first line 'Owner: docs-team'; the pre-merge check rejects files without it, and required content such as 'hello' must go on a later line.

[Lesson] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) When creating a team document in the docs project, add the required 'Owner: docs-team' header as the first line before submitting, otherwise the merge's pre-merge check fails.
